description: Read and conservatively classify only the exact inbound body behind one already-correlated canonical IMAP replied tracking event. This is not a mailbox browser: the server derives the workspace, mailbox, and Message-ID from the canonical event, reads no attachments or remote content, enforces byte/message caps, suppresses no-reply follow-ups, and never sends a response. The external tool is read-only and does not persist the inspection.

trackingEventId.description: Exact canonical IMAP replied TrackingEvent ID

workflowId.description: Exact workflow that owns the canonical replied tracking event

name: get_imap_reply_body
